Elements hidden via inline style="visibility:hidden" must not appear in the output

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><span style=\"visibility:hidden\">secret hidden span</span><p>also visible</p>")
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
